facts.claim: You cannot register an overseas marriage in Australia, but in most cases it is legally recognised if it was valid under the law of the country where it happened and would have been valid under Australian law had it occurred in Australia. A foreign marriage certificate is usually accepted as proof of the marriage, but may not be usable as proof of a name change; check with your state or territory BDM registry.
DFAT notarial fees from 1 January 2026: Certificate of No Impediment to Marriage AUD 181; apostille AUD 105 per document. Fees rise with CPI on 1 January each year.
facts.use_note: Optional, for the paperwork line. Write 'AUD 181 per CNI (DFAT fee for 2026)', only if the destination needs a CNI; say so conditionally.

facts.claim: Smartraveller says the right travel insurance is as essential as a passport for overseas travel, for every traveller.
Always read the Product Disclosure Statement (PDS) before buying; it sets out inclusions, exclusions, definitions, the claims process and emergency support.
